title: Once the sun sets, the real light show begins

location.series: KMS TEAM / Audi and Audi Sport identity case study

slide_intent: Place a substantial headline where it stays readable while the photograph supplies the experience, because a product claim needs both comprehension and context.
strategic_value: White Audi lettering and rings can identify the Q5 advertisement while the illuminated rear light makes its subject concrete.
demonstration: A large white multiline headline fills the upper left of a dusk photograph; white rings sit below, with a red rear light and a man at the car across the lower field.
practical_value: Judge how line breaks, contrast and image placement accommodate a long product headline.

content_islands.name: Headline
content_islands.spec: Align the white LED-technology headline at upper left, spanning several lines.

content_islands.name: Signature
content_islands.spec: Place white rings below the headline on the dark vehicle area.

content_islands.name: Photographic evidence
content_islands.spec: Keep the glowing red rear light low left and the person at lower right within the full-bleed dusk image.

reference_purposes.Expression: Large white typography and rings contrast with a dark photograph and red rear light.
reference_purposes.Application: The artwork applies the identity to an Audi Q5 rear-light advertisement.
